description: This file contains unit tests for the Markdown deserialization function used within a Slate editor implementation, specifically testing the conversion of Markdown strings into the editor's internal node structure. It includes various tests covering headings, code blocks, inline formatting, links, images, lists, HTML content, and references.

methods.name: deserializeMarkdown
methods.description: Function that creates an editor instance, sets data from a markdown string, inserts data into the editor, and returns the editor.
